name: Art Mes Delmann
text: Art Mes Delmann is a legendary king of the early days of the land known as Lagin. The records of the old age set him at the head of that region. He stands among the old rulers named before the modern books. Little of his own story has come down to the writers of this day.

attributes.attribute: legendary early king of the people of the Langin

okr.objective: Record the king of the people of the Lagin.
key_results: Set the king in the old roll.
Name the people of the region.
